scope.condition_for_future_use: Only consider this separate branch if the owner concludes the active branch is negative; this report does not make that determination.

current_mask_assessment.distance_definition: Hamming distance over the 18 binary skip indicators; for equal-size masks this equals the symmetric-difference cardinality. Distance 2 is one skipped-layer replacement (one swap), not a one-bit change.
current_mask_assessment.structural_conclusion: Each of the four named local masks is one swap from jac_anchor. Half of all ten fastpath pairs are one swap apart, and all five share skipped layers {2,3,17}. This describes mask geometry only; it says nothing about quality, efficacy, or complementarity.

runtime_constraints_from_source.layer_18: Not skip/capture eligible in the residual wrapper and never performs a hidden-state attention/FFN update in the current Triton encoder; preserve its existing terminal prefix-K/V behavior.
runtime_constraints_from_source.effective_update_count: With six skips drawn from layers 1-17, the current implementation updates hidden state in 11 of those 17 layers; layer 18 is a non-updating terminal shell. The nominal 12/18 count is the number of unmasked indices, not 12 full hidden-state updates.
runtime_constraints_from_source.layer_1: The source range permits skipping layer 1; the proposed initial panel keeps it retained as a conservative design choice, not because the code marks it unsupported or critical.
runtime_constraints_from_source.layer_17: Supported by the implementation and already skipped by the current masks, but it is the last position with an attention/FFN hidden-state update because layer 18 has none. p3_late_stride also skips layer 17 to probe this code-level execution difference; this is not a claim that layer 17 is semantically critical.
runtime_constraints_from_source.residual_identity: Every history and older-residual map must have exactly the same layer keys as the fixed mask. Do not change a mask within a path's episode history.
runtime_constraints_from_source.encoder_boundary: The intervention is confined to the VLM prefix encoder. Keep the existing full vision path and inherited action-expert sample path unchanged.
runtime_constraints_from_source.numeric_gate: Retain existing fixed-input implementation/parity requirements and atol=rtol=1e-5 as written; do not loosen tolerances to admit a candidate.

proposed_panel_distances.interpretation: The proposed masks are structurally farther from the existing one-swap family and from each other. Distance is a design descriptor only; no path is claimed to work better or to complement another.

tentative_official_init_ids.validation_required_before_any_future_fr: The prior asset audit found 50 initial states per task, while the current frozen source defines inits 36-43. These proposed IDs are not asserted unused or verified case-by-case; a separate pre-freeze availability check is required.

stages.name: static_usability
stages.budget: Zero episodes and zero model requests.
checks: Each mask has exactly six unique one-based layers in 1-17.
All arms share H50/R5, Full-D10/Fast-D2/Fast-D2, fixed mask, and own-path residual semantics.
stages.failure_action: Do not launch a scientific cohort; record the technical blocker without altering the current branch.

stages.name: fixed_input_usability_calibration
stages.request_sequence_per_task_and_arm: For each fast arm, A: Full-D10, Fast-D2, Fast-D2; B: Full-D10, Fast-D2, Fast-D2, where A/B are two initial observations of the same prompt. The Full control makes six Full-D10 requests.
stages.purpose: Technical usability only: prompt/input identity, fixed mask execution, two own-path residual histories, request schedule/noise bookkeeping, and existing numerical gates. No success or latency-based mask selection.
stages.physical_observation_capture_if_needed: At most four official reset observations and 40 settling actions; no policy actions are sent to the environment.

stages.name: discovery
stages.task_prompt_split: Within each metadata category, group tasks by exact official benchmark instruction so duplicate prompts cannot cross the split. Use an outcome-blind deterministic SHA-256 assignment to create 6 tasks/category (12 tasks total); finalize the exact groups only in a later separate protocol review.
stages.outcome_role: Exploratory only; all four new masks are fixed before any episode and none are selected using current-branch results.

stages.name: heldout
stages.task_prompt_split: The complementary prompt-group-disjoint 6 tasks/category; do not replace tasks after seeing discovery outcomes.
stages.outcome_role: Prospective heldout comparison of the four predeclared masks against Jac and Full; predeclare paired/category analyses and familywise handling before any future launch. Run the whole fixed panel, not a post-hoc winner subset.

maximum_closed_loop_budget.includes: All six arms in both discovery and heldout; technical calibration is separate and not counted as a policy episode.

identity_and_outcome_rules: Pair every arm on identical suite/task/init, official prompt, physical-state identity, environment seed 7, and condition-independent request-noise seed.
Preserve 10 settling steps, a 400-policy-action cap, and 20 Hz control.
Keep technical gate failures separate from policy outcomes; do not retry or replace a difficult case based on success or step count.
An old finite four-suite numeric gate is not evidence for the new prompt pool; check actual prompt and first-input identity on every future case.
limits: This is an illustrative maximum budget, not a runnable or frozen matrix.
The metadata pool has 12 tasks per category but only 20 distinct instruction strings; task/prompt separation does not make tasks statistically independent.
One new init pair per stage/task is a screening design, not an official full-init benchmark.
No future path-quality, efficiency, or complementarity claim follows from the proposed masks or budget.

owner_provided_resource_risk.note: A fresh model load for each condition can encounter an external-memory-availability gap and OOM even when a logical lease is held.
owner_provided_resource_risk.planning_implication: Before a future branch, plan fresh-service memory headroom and startup order explicitly. A persistent backend/config-switch is only a separately reviewed possibility; it would require unchanged numerical parity and a residual-state reset audit before execution.

prior_report_evidence.finding: Metadata-only proposal; 24 tasks split 12/12; 20 exact instruction strings; says no success, complementarity, latency, or adaptive benefit is established.
Proposal-only; old numeric gate does not cover the new task/prompt pool; new prompt/input/noise/physical state identities need per-case checks.
CPU asset audit found 50 official initial states per task; it does not certify rendered-environment or model/GPU readiness.
Prior runtime-only acceptance recorded fixed-mask execution and request schedule checks; its own limits say the fixed-input probe is not closed-loop acceleration or a path-quality/selection result.

source_evidence.supports: Task/category identities, exact five masks, fixed D schedule, six-condition whitelist, and current stage scope; a new panel must be versioned separately.
Current branch policy is a thin frozen-policy wrapper with an isolated condition validator.
The isolated wrapper delegates to the frozen VLM policy mechanics.
Fixed Full/Fast cadence, per-condition residual history, two-history extrapolation, and policy action acknowledgement.
Full vision projection, one-based skip/capture only for 1-17, exact residual-key identity, hidden updates only for first 17, and unchanged inherited sampling path.
Vision encoder runs before the VLM transformer; skip layer IDs are translated from one-based source masks to zero-based implementation indices.
Triton VLM has 18 zero-based positions, attention/FFN interventions only accept 0-16, and position 17/L18 has no hidden-state attention/FFN update.
Twelve nominal retained layers, H50/R5, D10 refresh, D2 drafts, own-path residual extrapolation, fixed mask, and preflight requirements with 1e-5 tolerances.

provenance_note: Mask distances were computed from the literal frozen source MASKS in common.py. Candidate masks and budget were chosen from layer geometry, source support limits, and prior metadata/runtime reports only; no current within_suite_v1 outcome or success statistic was read.
